snippet.title: Nemorsys | First Look | indie.io
snippet.description:
Wishlist Nemorsys now on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3517930/Nemorsys/ 

Join Kaelara on her quest for revenge against a tyrannical king. Become the Nemorsys, an ancient spirit of darkness, in this action stealth game where shadow and light shape every ability, and effect. Use powerful shadow powers, solve puzzles, and fight to overthrow an evil king.
